answer: A payout is split thus 31% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The quartz schedule is applied in bridge and kernel shows each instalment. An hostile operator hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4630 identities would post 811 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
